pin_row_note: Pin bases are smeared into their reflections on the glossy deck, so the base row is +-3 px (548-550 on P349_351, 555.8 on W352). Ball centre 550 at f349 vs base 548 (not yet), 550 vs 549 at f350. +-2 frames. The ball centre stays at y 549-550 from f350 to f358 while the camera tilts.
method: Every path point is a hand read from gridded crops of the SOURCE video (decoded sequentially): 3x ball crops and lane-width row crops with brightness/|dx| profiles for f304-336, then per-frame 5x-7x panels of the ball with each lane edge (panel_Z*, ZL*, W*, R*, L*) for f344-359, with the ball x, left_x and right_x averaged over 2-3 independent crops per frame; board = 1 + 38*(x - right_x)/(left_x - right_x) at the ball centre row (board_contact at about y+r where read). Entry board is the median of edge-profile reads at pin_hit-1..+1, a 6 in pin-column ruler (5.49 units per column, headpin = lowest base) at f354/356/358 and a ball-diameter ruler (2r = 7.8 units from the right edge) at f354/356/358.
limits: The ball runs 10-13 px inside the right gutter edge for the last 15 frames, so every far-end board rests on that gap: a 2-3 px edge or centre error is 1-1.5 boards, and the same frame read in two crops differed by up to 4 px (f352 right edge 560/565, f354 board 5.4-6.7). The ENTRY READS DISAGREE BY ~5 BOARDS: edges and the ball ruler put the ball at 6.7-8.7, the pin ruler at 0.0-3.8, because the 7 pin columns span 60 px against 85-88 px edge to edge (0.69 vs 0.87 expected) and the ball sits beside/right of the 10-pin column, far outside the rack where the ruler extrapolates; the median (6.9) is edge-led and the uncertainty is the half spread. hooks_back=true rests on f356-358 (6.2 -> 7.95, continuing to 8.7 at f359): a rise of 2.7 from the min 5.3 at f346, but inside the pin_hit +-2 window, so it may be pin contact rather than hook; the rack-relative ball offset also shrinks 36.5 -> 29.9 px over f354-358 (about 2 boards more than perspective), so two independent measures agree the ball moves left at the very end. Without f358 the rise is 0.9 and there is no hook. The pin base row is blurred into the deck reflection (+-3 px), so pin_row_frame is +-2 frames. Loop-1 truth read 4.5 +- 2.0 (edges 3.9-4.6, pin ruler 3.0); these reads are 1.5-2.5 boards higher on edges.
